products.name: DAVULA KEEPSAKE
products.desc: The Davula is a scaled-down replica of Sri Lanka’s traditional double-headed drum. Revered for its role in royal and religious ceremonies, this handcrafted piece embodies the island’s rich musical heritage and craftsmanship.
products.reason: A barrel-shaped drum played with one hand and a stick, the Davula is commonly used in Peraheras (processions) and ritualistic Buddhist ceremonies. It is also played in up-country (Kandyan) and low-country dance performances, providing a steady rhythmic beat.
products.Material: Premium mahogany wood and hand-painted lacquer.
products.Weight: 210 g – Lightweight yet durable, perfect for display or gifting.
products.Craftsmanship: Created by skilled Sri Lankan artisans using time-honored techniques.

products.name: Thammattama
products.desc: The Thammatama is a scaled-down replica of Sri Lanka’s iconic twin-drum set. Played with drumsticks, this handcrafted souvenir reflects the rhythmic essence and deep cultural roots of the island’s musical traditions.
products.reason: A twin-drum set, the Thammattama is played with two sticks and produces sharp, powerful beats. It is used in Buddhist temple rituals, Peraheras, and traditional dance performances. The drum is often played alongside other instruments to add rhythm to religious processions and ceremonial dances.
products.Material: Premium mahogany wood and hand-painted lacquer.
products.Weight: 210 g – Lightweight yet durable, perfect for display or gifting.
products.Craftsmanship: Created by skilled Sri Lankan artisans using time-honored techniques.

products.name: Pahatharata Beraya (Yak Beraya)
products.desc: The Pahatharata Beraya is a scaled-down replica of Sri Lanka’s low-country drum. Used in folk rituals and dances, this handcrafted piece symbolizes the island’s vibrant traditions and artistic craftsmanship.
products.reason: Also known as the 'Demon Drum,' this cylindrical drum is an essential instrument in low-country (Pahatharata) dance rituals. It is used in healing ceremonies like Bali and Thovil, where dancers invoke spirits to heal the sick or ward off evil influences.
products.Material: Premium mahogany wood and hand-painted lacquer.
products.Weight: 210 g – Lightweight yet durable, perfect for display or gifting.
products.Craftsmanship: Created by skilled Sri Lankan artisans using time-honored techniques.

products.name: Geta Beraya
products.desc: The Geta Bera Miniature is a scaled-down replica of Sri Lanka’s iconic ceremonial drum. Known for its vibrant rhythms and cultural significance, this handcrafted souvenir captures the artistry and tradition of the island’s rich heritage.
products.reason: Known as the 'drum of rituals,' this hourglass-shaped instrument is played in Buddhist ceremonies and Kandyan dances. Its distinct sound is achieved by tying one side tighter than the other, creating varying tones.
